 School Mail Telangana Telangana MLC Proposes Five-Day School Week, Seeks Saturday Holidays
 saniya anwar 9 Nov 2026 1:23 PM Share this: HYDERABAD: Schools in Hyderabad and other parts of Telangana may move to a five-day working week, with Saturdays declared holidays, if the state government accepts a proposal submitted by teacher constituency MLC Malka Komaraiah to Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy.
 The proposal comes amid concerns over the possible impact of El Niño , water availability and changing climatic conditions in the state. Komaraiah has suggested introducing the arrangement to help schools manage resources while reducing the burden on students during difficult weather conditions. 
 Schools may extend weekday timings by 35–40 minutes
 In his representation to the Chief Minister, the MLC proposed extending school hours by approximately 35 to 40 minutes from Monday to Friday to compensate for the instructional time lost due to Saturday holidays.
 Nalgonda workers struggle to complete mandatory face scans
 The adjustment, he suggested, would help schools complete the prescribed teaching hours despite moving to a five-day schedule.
 Komaraiah said the arrangement could also support water conservation, reduce traffic congestion and help lower vehicular pollution around schools. 
 Proposal cites water conservation and student welfare
 The MLC pointed out that declaring Saturdays as holidays would reduce the number of school-related vehicle trips during the week. This, he said, could ease traffic congestion and reduce emissions.
 He also highlighted the potential benefit to students, particularly during periods of high temperatures and difficult climatic conditions.
 “An additional weekly holiday would give students more time to rest and recover, particularly during periods of high temperatures and difficult climatic conditions,” he said.
 The proposal is being considered as a possible temporary measure in view of concerns over water availability in the coming months. However, the government has not announced any decision on implementing a five-day school week.
 November has two general holidays apart from Sundays
 According to the holiday details cited in the proposal, schools have two general holidays in November: Diwali on November 8 and Karthika Pournami on November 24. The month also has five Sundays.
 The proposal, if approved, would apply to schools in Hyderabad and other Telangana districts. Its implementation would require a government decision on the revised working schedule and instructional hours.
 For now, Saturday holidays remain a proposal submitted to the Chief Minister and should not be treated as an announced change to the school calendar.
